headline: V26-3512: keep deliveries on a shared base out of each other's way

V26-3319.title: Re-sync instead of restarting a check when the base moved only in files it doesn't read

criteria.text: When the base moved only in files outside the candidate's diff and its checks' readers, the candidate merges without re-running, and check.carried names the commits.
When the base moved in a file a selected check reads, only that check re-runs.
A base move that conflicts with the candidate stops it as today.
A binding with no readers mapping restarts every check as today. Each has a row in tests/test_merge_queue.py.

V26-3318.title: Share one merge slot for each base across every delivery's queue on a machine

criteria.text: Two deliveries' queues and a lead push run against one fixture base. No candidate stops with base_moved because of the other delivery, and a row pins it.
A lead push waits for a running check of another delivery, then lands after it ends.
A dead holder's slot is reclaimed, and a row pins it.
With one delivery, behaviour is unchanged.

V26-3425.title: Tell a fullHealth failure that passes alone from one that reproduces

criteria.text: A fullHealth whose only failure passes when rerun alone doesn't journal base.broken, and does record the test as flaky.
lead-resolve full-health with a moved head says what to do instead.

V26-3264.title: Run the lead's full suite in its own detached checkout of a commit

criteria.text: Running it at a commit and then editing the lead's checkout leaves the run's result unchanged.
The record carries the run's commit and toolchain.

V26-3320.title: Let deliveries on one base see each other and claim shared files

criteria.text: With two deliveries on one fixture base, doctor --delivery in each lists the other and what it is checking.
lead-accept on a candidate touching the other delivery's claimed file warns, naming the claim, and still accepts.
A peer's merge touching an open story's file is journaled in this delivery's record.
A delivery alone on its base shows no peers and no warnings.

V26-3513.title: Pin the merge slot's order and its wait, and say what to do when the slot is held
V26-3513.why: V26-3318's review aligned with three P2 and two P3 notes open: four missing rows for the slot's order and wait, and one guide sentence. The lead accepted V26-3318 so the peer story could start, and this story closes all five before integration.

criteria.text: A queue row with the slot wait unset and a small non-zero checkTimeoutSeconds shows the command's waiter file before it returns queue_locked, and fails when the wait is read as 0.
A row holds a delivery's queue.lock, runs a real queue command, and shows the holder file naming that delivery while the command waits; it fails when the queue lock is taken first.
A row shows lead-sync taking the merge slot before queue.lock, and fails when the order is swapped.

outOfScope: A lock or a registry that spans machines.
An order between deliveries, and claims on part of a file across deliveries.
A stopped post-merge `fullHealth`, which records no result today.
Carrying a base move in a batch, and a bound on how many base moves in a row one candidate is carried across.
Declaring `fullHealthRerun`, `selection.unread` or a complete readers entry in this repository's own binding.
A release tag. The lock change and the record's new kinds go out as a release candidate, cut separately.
